name: Philly Personal Fitness

reviews.text:
I have gotten stronger from lifting weights and bench pressing. I have been able to get better at squats. I have also had been able to improve my skills of lifting.
I have made friends from working out there and having a personal trainer is good
reviews.author: Henry Football cards and stickers 5

reviews.text: So grateful for this gym, the owner/my trainer, & the community. Doing a combination of individual & group sessions, as well as nutrition coaching, has been a game changer for me. Gary has designed a specific program for me to help me meet my goals, yet take into account where I am at as someone getting back into working out after some time off. Love the environment, how supportive all the trainers & other members are, how ridiculously clean & immaculate they keep the gym, and feeling part of the community 🫶🫶
reviews.author: N A

reviews.text: I love this gym! Of course my fitness level has grown, but so has my community. The workouts are designed to meet you where you are and provide you with a safe and challenging workout no matter what your skill or experience level is. The coaches will push you to stretch and rethink the limits of your comfort zone while prioritizing safety, integrity, and quality of movement above all else. Come build muscle and friendships with us. It's a good time!
reviews.author: Bee Reed

reviews.text: Philly Personal Fitness has been a game changer for me! I’ve been attending classes and doing personal training with Sean T, and I can’t say enough good things. Sean’s expertise has been instrumental in helping me fix my mobility and knee issues that I’ve struggled with for years. The workouts are always tailored to my needs, challenging to keep me moving forward , and I’ve seen consistent progress. The environment is welcoming, supportive, and motivating. If you’re looking for a personalized fitness experience that really works, this is the place to be!
reviews.author: James Craggs

reviews.text: Workouts here are motivating and effective—the trainers really know how to push you while keeping things fun. I always leave feeling stronger and more energized.
reviews.author: Fran Sekulić
